# Contributing

Open an issue before starting work on a feature.

## Generative AI

You may use AI tools, but you must disclose it in the pull request description, for example:
"This PR was written in part with the assistance of generative AI".
Do not list an AI tool as a co-author, and do not add assisted-by or co-developed-by trailers.
Replies to review comments must be written by you, without AI.
